steps.name: Aulus
steps.text: I'm a little surprised.

steps.name: Abbot
steps.text: Because I've come to turn my back on the faith?

steps.name: Aulus
steps.text: Because of what you're evading, Stefano.

steps.name: Aulus
steps.text: I don't know whether you're under some outside influence, but if...

steps.name: Abbot
steps.text: There are no ifs, Aulus.

steps.name: Abbot
steps.text: I am not so far gone that Arts would sway me.

steps.name: Aulus
steps.text: There are times when Arts doesn't need to change our minds at all. All too many things can impact us, Stefano.

steps.name: Abbot
steps.text: You are asking that I reconsider. Why, heretic priest?

steps.name: Abbot
steps.text: Is this decision of mine not what you always wanted to see?

steps.name: Aulus
steps.text: I can't deny it.

steps.name: Aulus
steps.text: But in turn, I have to recognize that back when this extraordinary building was still in Iberia, it was my fortune to study here, and those days were precious like little else to me then.

steps.name: Aulus
steps.text: In this way, Stefano, I'm just like you. I feel for this place, just as you do.

steps.name: Aulus
steps.text: I still remember the cleric who came with you from Laterano.

steps.name: Aulus
steps.text: I remember very many.

steps.name: Abbot
steps.text: The one you recall took his gun, sixty years ago, and made the decision to fall in line with the Church of then. While I...

steps.name: Abbot
steps.text: I chose to stay behind, and protect those who were left.

steps.name: Aulus
steps.text: And this fed your faith, enduring until now.

steps.name: Abbot
steps.text: If you know so well, why would you still have me continue to wait, to endure?

steps.name: Abbot
steps.text: Are you about to refute all that you've maintained and proclaimed, just to turn around and tell me to deliberate, exhort me to stay fast?

steps.name: Aulus
steps.text: Of course not. Stefano, you know I wouldn't.

steps.name: Aulus
steps.text: But at core, I walk the path I believe is right, and so I would hope I could say the same of you.

steps.name: Aulus
steps.text: Tomorrow morning, should you still be committed, I will consider it your choice then.

steps.name: Aulus
steps.text: I will prepare what you need.

steps.name: Aulus
steps.text: If you are not yet decided, I will advise you to continue contemplation.

steps.name: Aulus
steps.text: Whatever it may be... I hope your decision will be that you find truest.

steps.name: Abbot
steps.text: Aulus, you wrongly assume one thing.

steps.name: Aulus
steps.text: And what is right?

steps.name: Abbot
steps.text: I am lost for any other choice.

steps.name: Aulus
steps.text: Very well. Should this be Truth's ordain...

steps.name: Aulus
steps.text: Then I will welcome you, Stefano, my brother anew.

steps.name: Serpilia
steps.text: Mind if I come in?

steps.name: Fortuna
steps.text: ...You can.

steps.name: Serpilia
steps.text: 'Scuse me.

steps.name: Serpilia
steps.text: You're not doing too hot, then?

steps.name: Fortuna
steps.text: ...Can I ask a question?

steps.name: Serpilia
steps.text: Sure.

steps.name: Fortuna
steps.text: Is... Is Fina not...?

steps.name: Fortuna
steps.text: With us anymore?

steps.name: Serpilia
steps.text: Not to push you, but I'd prefer some other question.

steps.name: Serpilia
steps.text: I'm not really up for lying to you.

steps.name: Fortuna
steps.text: Okay.

steps.name: Fortuna
steps.text: Actually, I had an inkling all along...

steps.name: Fortuna
steps.text: When it happened, I just suddenly—couldn't feel Fina anymore... even though she was so angry, and so upset...

steps.name: Fortuna
steps.text: And she was right there in front of me, right...? But I couldn't find her anywhere...

steps.name: Serpilia
steps.text: If I hadn't helped you fix up that gun...

steps.name: Fortuna
steps.text: No!

steps.name: Fortuna
steps.text: Don't say it, please...

steps.name: Serpilia
steps.text: ...Alright.

steps.name: Fortuna
steps.text: I felt the horns—on my head. They're horns just like Raimund's.

steps.name: Fortuna
steps.text: I can't ever pray holding my gun again, but at least...

steps.name: Fortuna
steps.text: I finally—fit in, with Raimund, and Caroline...

steps.name: Fortuna
steps.text: I fit in with everybody.
Hah, the flowers weren't blooming this early last year. Funny timing now, hm?

steps.name: Raimund
steps.text: No complaints, though. One last bloom for the road.

steps.name: Raimund
steps.text: And so...

steps.name: Raimund
steps.text: That'll do it...

steps.name: Lemuen
steps.text: Repeat that... we have a fallen angel? That Fortuna girl?

steps.name: Federico
steps.text: Yes.

steps.name: Lemuen
steps.text: I wasn't expecting that one, let me tell you...

steps.name: Lemuen
steps.text: Fallen... Our only option is to hold on until we get back, then let His Holiness decide. It's not something we can handle right here.

steps.name: Lemuen
steps.text: But that surprise visitor who barged into my room is a different story. Federico, there's some things I'll explain to you later... for now, anything's a non-starter unless we find that visitor, whatever it is.

steps.name: Lemuen
steps.text: I require your assistance, Executor Federico.

steps.name: Lemuen
steps.text: It has mobility on its side. I managed to chase it down this far, but that was a stretch, and I've lost it now anyway.

steps.name: Lemuen
steps.text: Huh, no immediate reply?

steps.name: Lemuen
steps.text: That's rare. You're making me feel like something bad happened to you... Hey, I see those knit brows. Something bad did happen, then?

steps.name: Federico
steps.text: ...I heard strings.

steps.name: Lemuen
steps.text: Strings? Did... you? I don't think I heard anything...?

steps.name: Federico
steps.text: Based on my inference, the sound came from the sacrarium on the top floor.

steps.name: Lemuen
steps.text: Right...

steps.name: Lemuen
steps.text: Let me be real. I've gotten to know the length and breadth of your work at the Notarial Hall, which is why I'm relatively willing to trust your judgment.

steps.name: Lemuen
steps.text: I am now formally querying you—

steps.name: Lemuen
steps.text: Notarial Hall Executor Federico, do you truly believe this unidentified, unascertained, and possibly completely benign sound of strings—

steps.name: Lemuen
steps.text: Stands to be more important than the request for assistance I'm making of you?

steps.name: Federico
steps.text: It does not.

steps.name: Lemuen
steps.text: Obviously not.

steps.name: Federico
steps.text: The occurrence of the sound is a chance event. I have suspicions about it, but I cannot deny that I as of yet find no direct correlation between it and our catalog of current affairs.

steps.name: Federico
steps.text: Based on present circumstances, I judge that priority should be given to providing requisite assistance, in tandem operation with you.

steps.name: Lemuen
steps.text: Heheh. All done then?

steps.name: Lemuen
steps.text: Alright, alright, I'm not here to bully you anyway. Just, I do need to check in with how you're doing real quick.

steps.name: Lemuen
steps.text: I see now.

steps.name: Lemuen
steps.text: Point me in a direction. I'll continue target pursuit, and I'll leave you to sort out the strings debacle.

steps.name: Federico
steps.text: This mission requires that we prioritize assuring yours and Oren's safety.

steps.name: Lemuen
steps.text: Due diligence is great and all, but I say priority's the kind of thing you need to judge yourself.

steps.name: Lemuen
steps.text: I can't sense your emotions, Federico. Still, I have this Liberi friend, see, who's the reason I learned long ago how to guess what people are thinking. Couldn't do empathy with her, after all.

steps.name: Lemuen
steps.text: She might be a lot easier to figure out than you are, but some things carry over.

steps.name: Lemuen
steps.text: One teensy little word of advice—maybe sometimes, you need to learn to trust your instinct.

steps.name: Lemuen
steps.text: That settles that. We don't have time to waste... and I've gotta force myself to be a little active anyway.

steps.name: Lemuen
steps.text: Operation a-go! Move out, everyone~

steps.name: Federico
steps.text: Speed up.

steps.name: Clément
steps.text: Senior Federico! W—Wait one moment, please!

steps.name: Clément
steps.text: What exactly do... you think is up there? It was just the sound of strings, and we can't even hear it anymore!

steps.name: Clément
steps.text: Are—Are we really going to let the seniora brave the danger on her own? She's in a wheelchair, after all...

steps.name: Federico
steps.text: You have no need to worry.

steps.name: Clément
steps.text: How could I not worry? I just saw it myself... it was a monster!

spans.text: worry? I just saw it myself... it was a monster!

steps.name: Federico
steps.text: Lemuen was admitted into the Lateran by personal invitation of a Cardinal of the Seventh Tribunal. Her strength defies any contempt.

steps.name: Federico
steps.text: Do not underestimate her.

steps.name: Clément
steps.text: I don't quite follow what you're telling me—I assume you mean she's just as mighty herself?

steps.name: Clément
steps.text: But... what if?

steps.name: Federico
steps.text: Speed up. Or stay where you are and wait.

steps.name: Federico
steps.text: I suggest you pick the latter. It is the safer option.

steps.name: Federico
steps.text: (Empty?)

steps.name: Federico
steps.text: (No.)
Subtle noises spill through the spacious sacrarium. The loading of the gun keeps audible lockstep rhythm.
The executor suddenly points.

steps.name: Federico
steps.text: Come out.

steps.name: Federico
steps.text: I will only warn you once more. Come out from there.

steps.name: Lively Child
steps.text: Ah... he found us.

steps.name: Shy Child
steps.text: He found us. He's just like the lady said...

steps.name: Lively Child
steps.text: Yeah, the big man found us right away!

steps.name: Shy Child
steps.text: Is—Is he really the man she was talking about?

steps.name: Lively Child
steps.text: He's got the wings and ring and they're all black. It's him, must be.

steps.name: Lively Child
steps.text: Mister, my name is Erendel!

steps.name: Shy Child
steps.text: I'm Estara...

steps.name: Federico
steps.text: Where is the woman who described me to you?

steps.name: Estara
steps.text: He looks really, really scary...

steps.name: Erendel
steps.text: You're too scary! And you didn't even say your name... that's just rude!

steps.name: Estara
steps.text: Mamma says if you don't know someone's name and they're a stranger, you shouldn't tell them anything...

steps.name: Federico
steps.text: Federico.

steps.name: Estara
steps.text: Senior Federico's scary. Is he a good guy...?

steps.name: Erendel
steps.text: I bet he is! Just like in the story.

steps.name: Estara
steps.text: W—We can tell him, then, right?

steps.name: Erendel
steps.text: Probably we can?

steps.name: Estara
steps.text: Um... well...

steps.name: Estara
steps.text: Someone told us...

steps.name: Erendel
steps.text: We had to wait here for a really scary big man with a black ring on his head just like she has!

steps.name: Estara
steps.text: And she—she said you'd find Mamma with us...

steps.name: Erendel
steps.text: Yeah! And also she said we were only allowed to wait a little, tiny bit! And if you didn't come, then we come out ourselves.

steps.name: Estara
steps.text: Um... she said we couldn't stay here forever.

steps.name: Estara
steps.text: And also, also, she said...

steps.name: Estara & Erendel
steps.text: Eek!

steps.name: Estara & Erendel
steps.text: Senior, Senior! Quick... there's a fire!

steps.name: Estara
steps.text: Wah!

steps.name: Erendel
steps.text: Waargh!

steps.name: Federico
steps.text: Get out for now.

steps.name: Federico
steps.text: Cover your mouth and nose. A fire has broken out.
